tools.name: detect_courier
tools.description: Detect and identify which courier company or carrier matches a given tracking number.

number.description: Tracking number or AWB to identify.

tools.name: navigate_page
tools.description: Navigate to a specific section on Track91 (e.g., track, couriers, speedpost, contact, mcp).

tools.name: search_couriers
tools.description: Search and browse supported delivery companies and couriers on Track91.

query.description: Courier or carrier name to search for (e.g. FedEx, DHL, DTDC, Speed Post).

tools.name: track_shipment
tools.description: Track a package or shipment across 100+ global couriers using tracking number and optional courier code.

number.description: The shipment tracking number, AWB, or reference code.

courier.description: Optional courier code or slug (e.g. delhivery, dtdc, speedpost, blue-dart).
